primitives.name: Collective Will Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: Instead, the really capable coach becomes, in these tense days, a comrade in arms, talking in quiet, sober fashion of his own hopes and desires, and, when he addresses the team in a body, suggesting rather than pleading for the spirit he must somehow stir.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'W_c': 'Will coefficient of coach (dimensionless)', 'T': 'Team cohesion tensor (dimensionless)', 'S': 'Spirit vector (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Coach's influence is modeled as a linear transformation of team spirit through shared aspiration.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When W_c < 0.5, team motivation decays exponentially with increasing individualism.

layer2.mapping: GSI Bayesian update on T given S and W_c; GSE state transition from S to S' via motivational input.
layer2.telemetry: Team morale index, coach-stated intent alignment

primitives.name: Motivational Framing Function
primitives.verbatim_quote: The statement, in a blunt, plain phrase or two, that this is after all a fighting game and that the fighting team wins at it carries about as much effect as an hour of eloquence.
primitives.assumptions: F_m is inversely proportional to time spent in elaboration.
primitives.breakdown_regime: F_m → 0 as T → ∞; optimal effectiveness within 1–3 seconds.

layer2.mapping: GSI entropy reduction in motivational uncertainty; GSE tactical decision latency under framing.
layer2.telemetry: Decision speed post-framing, emotional arousal level

primitives.name: Devotion-Driven Effort
primitives.verbatim_quote: What really draws the final ounce of a man's strength and speed and courage is devotion to something bigger and finer than himself.
primitives.assumptions: E = D × M where D ∈ [0,1] represents normalized devotion.
primitives.breakdown_regime: E maxes at M when D = 1; effort vanishes when D = 0.

layer2.mapping: GSI utility maximization under devotion constraint; GSE effort-state evolution driven by D.
layer2.telemetry: Player exertion rate, team unity score
